explanation.surface: Someone struggling to put on clothes before a crowd of people.
explanation.definitionFit: Something trying is wearing and tedious, testing one's patience.

clue.text: Sewing material that's right. in the modern era

clue.text: A beast with guns turned up

clue.text: The' man from Dorset has got the post

clue.text: Pretty rural cottage providing a home for a story-writer

clue.text: Order giving rise to anger
